title: Chapter 1090
text:
The Holy Light Particle was injected into Aurora's body, and it began to fuse with her cells. The Life Arcana in her body also instantly became restless, producing an intense reaction.

Platinum light shone out from every inch of Aurora's skin, and she turned into a dazzling human-shaped light source. Every strand of her hair seemed to have materialized as she floated in the air, exuding a noble, beautiful, and holy aura.

His eyes quickly adapted to the strong light, and Han Xiao stared at the transforming Aurora with his eyes wide open. He held the empty containment device, and once there were signs of backlash, he would give Aurora another injection to suck out the Holy Light Particle.

To Han Xiao's relief, the fusion process was very smooth. When the light faded, Aurora slowly landed on the ground, as if she was still immersed in the feeling just now.

Snap!

Han Xiao snapped his fingers in front of her eyes. "How do you feel?"

"It seems … quite comfortable?"

Aurora covered her chest with a look of uncertainty.

"Since there is no backlash, you are already the host of the Holy Light Particle. Can you feel its power?"

"You mean this?"

Aurora closed her eyes and felt it for a moment. She then extended her hand, palm facing up, and shook it slightly. Immediately, a cluster of golden light popped out. The particles were very strong, like a group of fireflies gathered together.

She grasped it so quickly? Generally speaking, the host would need a period of adaptation after fusing with the Primal Arcana.

It was said that the shorter the adaptation period, the higher the compatibility of the host.

The characteristics of the Life Arcana and the Holy Light Particle are indeed very compatible, and there might be some kind of chemical reaction. This way, I can maximize the use of the Holy Light Particle, and it will be convenient for me to carry out my plan … Han Xiao stroked his chin.

He raised his hand to touch the cluster of light in Aurora's palm, and this cluster of light actually dodged to the side. Han Xiao was amused.

"Ah Sheng, I know that you can share the host's senses after the fusion and can hear me. Don't play dead. How is this host?"

"Hmm …"

The Holy Light Particle bubbled and let out a comfortable snoring sound like a cat stretching itself. It no longer despised Aurora and immediately changed its words.

"It's so comfortable. This is the first time I've felt such surging vitality. This is the best host I've ever experienced …"

"Hmph, that's not what you said just now." Aurora wrinkled her nose in dissatisfaction.

"I was wrong. Other than you, no one else is worthy of me ~" The Holy Light Particle circled around Aurora like a spoiled puppy that was pestering its owner.

Han Xiao curled his lips.

Tsk, weren't you acting tough just now? In the blink of an eye, you've become a bootlicker. Tell me, isn't it nice?

Aurora practiced for a while and soon got used to it. In her perception, it was as if she had suddenly gained a new limb that she could control with ease.

"Practice more when you get back. The Primal Esper Ability has multiple effects. With the Holy Light Particle, your self-protection ability will also rise to the next level," Han Xiao reminded.

Aurora's role was to be a healer, and her life Esper Ability lacked combat power. Now that she had become the host of the Holy Light Particle, she had obtained new abilities such as strengthening her physique, super speed, dimension travel, and punishing evil.

Especially the dimension travel, which allowed her mobility to jump several levels. If she encountered any danger in the future, it would be much easier for her to escape.

However, what Han Xiao valued the most was the ability to provide Holy Light Seeds. He tested it and was pleasantly surprised to find that his idea was correct. Aurora's life Esper Ability could indeed replenish the consumption of the Holy Light Particle's origin core. This meant that the new energy system of providing Holy Light Seeds in batches was feasible.

This was very useful to the Black Star Corps. On one hand, it could motivate the players and army soldiers. On the other hand, it could attract a large number of ordinary people and let them see the hope of becoming Supers.

Han Xiao explained his idea to her. Aurora was a little scared, and her tone was a little timid.

"You want to popularize it on a large scale?"

"More or less, but now that you're the host, I have to get your permission."

Hearing this, Aurora wanted to say something but stopped.

She had just tested the ability to split the Holy Light Seed. Although her body could withstand it, it would consume a lot of life energy. If she used it on a large scale, she did not know if the life energy she naturally accumulated every day would be enough. She might even experience the feeling of being drained dry every day.

After hesitating for a while, Aurora suddenly made up her mind, closed her eyes, and said firmly, "Alright, I — I can withstand it!"

"Why do you look like you're going to die honorably?" Han Xiao pinched her nose and joked. "Don't worry, I won't let you bleed for nothing. You can take back the Holy Light Seed. Not only can this replenish your energy, it can also help you grow faster. It's much faster than you accumulating life energy every day."

"It's not good to take away the fruits of other people's hard work like this …" Aurora was a little resistant. This was not in line with her principles.

"Hahaha …" Han Xiao laughed and said with the tone of a big capitalist, "Isn't that simple? Money can't solve everything, but it can solve most problems. I'll hire a group of people, and their job is to cultivate the Holy Light Seed. After they cultivate it, they'll harvest it for you. Actually, this is no different from working for me. It's just that the content of the job is different. In essence, it's them contributing their time to create value for me. As long as the remuneration is enough, it's a mutually agreeable transaction. There's no need to feel guilty. "

"That makes sense …" Although Aurora was more of a lawful kind person, she was not stubborn. She did not have any resistance after hearing this.

Taking away the fruits of other people's hard work without saying anything and saying that it was a job from the start were two completely different things. Using meditation and rituals to cultivate the Holy Light Seed could also be used to clock in. In essence, it was no different from the army's clerks. They were all workers.

Han Xiao chose Aurora as his host not only to maximize the potential of the Holy Light Seed but also to let Aurora enjoy the leek growth rate of the Holy Light Seed and increase her leveling speed.

In any case, Aurora did not have any bottlenecks. Harvesting leeks was many times faster than accumulating life force naturally. It was equivalent to a large group of people helping her accumulate experience. In his eyes, it was similar to the Shadow Clone Technique.

The sooner Aurora stepped into a new level, the sooner the Germinal Organization would have three Beyond Grade A Supers.

After encountering the Underworld dimension, Han Xiao already had such thoughts. His goal was not to improve Aurora's healing ability but the effect of the Underworld. Only when Aurora reached Beyond Grade A could she complete the 'Edo Tensei' operation …

Compared to her healing ability, Han Xiao was more interested in the group of experts sleeping in the Underworld. They were a group of super strong combatants.

I'm really a little genius … Han Xiao chuckled.

The only hidden danger was the Holy Covenant Organization. This group of people had an extraordinary interest in Primal Esper Abilities. If they knew that the Holy Light Seed was on Aurora, they would most likely find a chance to snatch it.

However, this was also a good way to lure the snake out of its hole. If the Holy Covenant Organization continued to hide, he would not be able to find them. The Holy Covenant Organization might not have the guts to attack him again, but they would definitely dare to attack the Supers under him.

As for Aurora's safety, Han Xiao naturally would not neglect it. He was prepared to give Aurora a King mechanical suit as well.

Not only that, he also planned to build a few more sets of spare King and place the teleportation locator 'Throne' on different people to ensure that he could descend at any time. The King was purely a teleportation device.

The King was expensive to build, so it was very extravagant. However, as a shareholder of the Limitless Financial Group and the profitable business of the Evolutionary Totem, he could earn a large amount of Enas every year. His money was more than enough to cover this part of the cost.

After giving some instructions, Han Xiao told Aurora to go back and properly develop the Holy Light Seed. When she was ready, he would start the Holy Light Emissary plan.

Watching Aurora leave the room, Han Xiao could not help but think of Evans.

The two Goldfingers of this old man in his previous life had been taken away by him.

"How's Evans doing now?"

Philip popped his head out. "He's still figuring out his Esper Ability, hum …"

Han Xiao looked at the monitor. Ever since Evans was sent back by him, he had been receiving secret training. Because he did not have any instructions, he had not copied a single Esper Ability yet. He had no combat ability and was at the lowest Grade E.

"Have you found the target I asked you to find?" Han Xiao asked.

"I've locked onto the Immortals with matching abilities. The list is as follows, hum …"

A pocket-sized bookcase appeared next to Philip. He rummaged through it and took out a stack of information. He threw it into the air, and the flying pieces of paper turned into virtual screens, showing the files of different people, floating in front of Han Xiao.

Han Xiao could not help but glance at him.

Young man, why are you so dramatic? Are you giving me a show?

While pressing Philip's face with his fingers and rubbing him back and forth on the table, Han Xiao quickly read through the files.

His new EsGod cultivation plan followed the path of absorption and planned the growth path for Evans. He had always been looking for the most suitable Esper Abilities to possess early on, and the players in these files all belonged to two specific types of Esper Ability Users — the physical strengthening type and the mental strengthening type.

The burden of Grade E was not high, and copying two was the most suitable. Body and mind were the most important basic qualities, so this was the most optimal configuration. Evans had his support and did not need to walk the same path as EsGod, so he did not have to worry about his early combat strength. His main goal was to build a foundation.

"Just these two."

After choosing the two players with the best abilities, Han Xiao asked Philip to give them exclusive missions.

At this time, the interface suddenly had a notification.

[Liberating Beast Ancestor Forces] Completed!

"Oh? The troops sent out a few months ago succeeded? "Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Before going to the secondary dimensions, a group of Beast Ancestor officers led by Jotina had come to him and made a request to liberate the Beast Ancestor's base.

At that time, Han Xiao had given the mission to the Shattered Star Ring's main forces. Now that a few months had passed, there were finally results. It seemed to be very successful, and there should be a bunch of new people who would recognize him as their father soon.

…

The last planet of Beast Ancestor's base was ablaze, as if the earth was burning. The planet's defense facilities had all been destroyed, and a large number of spaceship fragments were floating in outer space.

Black Star Corps battleships floated above the planet, using tractor beams to absorb a large number of resources and countless captives. Most of them were rescued mothers and ignorant young offspring.

In the cabin of one of the transport ships, captives of different species were huddled together in groups of two or three, full of uneasiness. Teams of Black Star Warriors pulled everyone apart, separating the warriors, mothers, young offspring, and other captives.

"Don't move, stand still!"

The captain of the transport ship commanded loudly.

At the side, Mia, who was wearing a black combat suit and dressed in the style of Hella, had her hands crossed, using her forearm to support a mechanical spear. Her upper body leaned forward, placing her center of gravity on her arm. Her fingers were holding a bag of snacks, popping candy into her mouth from time to time. Her eyes scanned the large group of captives in front of her.

Teams of Beast Ancestor captives were sucked into the cabin, and the crowd was a little restless, seemingly having the intention to resist. However, when they saw Mia standing by the wall, these restless captives trembled and quickly gave up on the idea.

In the battle just now, they had personally seen a Calamity Grade officer guarding the base being brutally chopped into pieces by Mia. No one dared to mess around in front of her.

At this time, there was a commotion not far away. Mia turned around and saw a few rescued mothers arguing with the Black Star Warriors.

"Who are you people? Do you know who our spouse is? How dare you offend us! "

"Let go, don't pull me!"

"When His Excellency Beast Ancestor returns, he'll crush you to death!"

These fellows were pushed into the crowd by the Black Star Warriors, but they were still cursing and swearing. They could not stop mentioning the name of the Beast Ancestor.

Looking at this scene, Mia pursed her lips and shook her head.

At this time, the captain of the transport ship sighed.

"It's very sad, isn't it? These mothers that are under house arrest by Beast Ancestor are basically isolated from the outside world. To most people, this is a dark and hopeless life, but there are a few people who are distorted and worship Beast Ancestor instead, taking pride in this identity. Although our mission is to save these mothers, there might be many people who do not want to be saved by us and only want to continue with their previous lives. "

Mia glanced at him and said, "Do your job. I only have the mission in my eyes. I'm not interested in this kind of thing."

The captain of the transport ship stopped talking and continued to instruct his subordinates to do their work.

At this time, Mia's communicator rang. Jotina's flirtatious and wild face popped up, but this face was now filled with a holy and motherly Radiance.

"How are the mothers and their offspring? Have they been saved? "Jotina asked impatiently.

Mia smiled and said, "Don't worry, they've been saved. They're all very touched."

"That's great. I'll report the good news to the Army Commander now!" Jotina was overjoyed. "By the way, when you come back, I'll teach you a few powerful moves."

Without waiting for a reply, Jotina hastily hung up the communication.

"What an impatient person." Mia laughed.

Although Jotina had made a mating request to her boss in public and was shocked for a moment, after interacting with her for a while, the army officers realized that she was actually very easy to get along with. She had a straightforward and decisive personality, and after a few months, she had become quite popular.

This was especially so for Mia, who had the best relationship with her. Both of them were muscular and had endless common topics to talk about.

Putting away the communicator, Mia looked at the crowd in front of her again. Her gaze swept across the confused and panicked faces, and she heaved a sigh of relief.

"Nero, your godfather is really an incredible person. As expected of the man that even Her Excellency Hella is willing to follow …"

Although Black Star had defeated Gorután out of personal revenge, the result was indeed a great thing for the entire universe. Mia admired him from the bottom of her heart.
